in_marathi.name: Mustaq
in_marathi.long_meaning: Mustaq हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Mustaq is a Hindi and Urdu name that means turmeric. It is a strong and courageous name that is often given to boys. Turmeric is a powerful spice that is used in many Indian dishes and has numerous health benefits. The name Mustaq is believed to bring strength and resilience to those who bear it.
